Toddler meals

Egg muffins

Tojásmuffin

6 months+ Adjusted 25 min 6 portions

Offer a soft piece from six months, as an early egg food. Check the centre is set before you serve it.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 3 Eggs (Beaten)
  • 60 ml Full-fat milk (Pasteurized)
  • 1 small Carrot (Finely grated)
  • 1 small Zucchini (Finely grated and squeezed dry)

Allergens

eggmilk

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Beat the eggs with the milk.
  3. Stir in the carrot and zucchini.
  4. Divide between six small tins.
  5. Bake until fully set and no liquid egg remains, about 15 minutes.
  6. Cool until warm and cut into soft pieces.

Adjusted

Ham is salty and cured, so it is left out, and no salt is added. Waiting past six months is not necessary for egg.

Bake egg and milk with grated carrot and zucchini until fully set. These are a good early egg food; do not wait.
